title: A repayment on a FRAUD loan marked charged off credits INCOME_FROM_RECOVERY 643.00 for its 633.00 principal and 10.00 interest, MERGED, then debits the resolved fund source 1 exactly ONCE (loan 19 L61)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a REPAYMENT posted on a loan ALREADY MARKED CHARGED OFF under createJournalEntriesForRepaymentWhenLoanIsChargedOff, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1_INTEREST_FLAT / loanProductId 3, loan 19 chargedOff true, fraud true) at repayment transaction L61. request.charged_off_repayment_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's repayment transaction id 61 (externalId 3b52ebe2-0312-47c7-a56f-c4b0fcb54692, type loanTransactionType.repayment, paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 5): principalPortion 633.0 -> "63300", interestPortion 10.0 -> "1000", feeCharges/penaltyCharges/overpaymentPortion 0 and omitted. The repayment is preceded in the read-back by the loan's NON-REVERSED chargeOff transaction id 59, so the loan is already marked charged off when L61 posts. request.charged_off_repayment_journal.accounts is the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP1_INTEREST_FLAT.json's accountingMappings with the fund source RESOLVED through the payment channel: incomeFromRecoveryAccountId 17 (Recoveries), loanPortfolioAccountId 6, receivableInterestAccountId 10, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 16, fundSourceAccountId 1; the ONLY paymentChannelToFundSourceMappings entry is paymentTypeId 1 -> 18, so paymentType 5 has no channel mapping and resolves to the product fund source 1. expect.charged_off_repayment_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L61 legs in id order from the journal-entries read-back: JE 175 CREDIT glAccountId 17 643.00, JE 176 DEBIT glAccountId 1 643.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a repayment on a charged-off loan CREDITS every positive principal, interest, fee and penalty portion to INCOME_FROM_RECOVERY — whatever the fraud flag — MERGING those slots into one credit at the first slot's position, then DEBITs the total exactly ONCE to the resolved fund source. The 63300 principal and 1000 interest share the recovery account 17, so the merged-credit branch IS exercised: a port that posts the repayment like an ordinary one emits TWO credits (63300 to account 6, 1000 to account 10) instead of the one merged 64300 credit to 17, and a port that ignores the charge-off state in any other way moves a leg. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive fee, penalty or overpayment portion (all three are zero here — the principal-only loan-37 vector grades a second shape); the fraud flag's effect on the recovery account (there is none — this branch never reads it, and both observations share account 17); the method's unobserved merchant-issued-refund, payout-refund, goodwill-credit and else branches (no transaction-type input exists). The journal-entries read-back holds only these two legs for L61, both reversed false, so no later reversal is mixed in. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
